storia.foto_alt: Laura writing travel notes in a notebook
apertura: My name is Laura. I was born in Sardinia in 1989, and travelling is not simply an escape for me: it is how I feel alive.

My passion for travel turned into a profession when I decided to complete my Travel Designer training. It was a wonderful experience that allowed me to broaden my passion, enriching it with the technical skills needed to organise every itinerary in practice.
racconto: I have a natural fondness for equatorial latitudes, for warm lands where the air grows dense and smells of spices and memory. From the heart of South-East Asia to the peaks of Nepal, all the way to the lights of Africa, between the red of Morocco and the vastness of the plains of Kenya and Tanzania: these are the places where I truly feel at home.

Rotte d’incenso was born from a precise inclination: a pull towards places where you can breathe an authentic spirituality, far from the rhythms of the Western world. I feel a sincere nostalgia for the atmospheres of another time, for those corners of the planet that still guard ancient traditions and human rhythms.
It is an inspiration that comes from afar, born also from devouring the books of Tiziano Terzani, who taught me to look at Asia and the world with respect, slowness, curiosity and nostalgia.

One evening, talking about travel with a friend, she asked me: «And Latin America, when?». I told her that I am happy to design Latin America for those who ask me, but that my nose keeps following the scent of incense, and it always leads in the same direction. She looked at me with a smile and said:
storia.chiusura_citazione: I was moved: I believe that sentence defines me perfectly.
storia.chiusura: I don’t create mass-produced itineraries. I design journeys for those seeking encounters, a deeper gaze and a reconnection with the authentic beauty of the world.

valori.sottotitolo: The three pillars on which I build every single itinerary.

lista.testo: The time to truly enter a place, far from the frenzy of mass tourism.
Real connections with local communities, artisans and preserved traditions.
A gentle impact on the places we visit, supporting circular economies.

come_lavoriamo.sottotitolo: Four steps, from the first wish to departure.

passi.testo: A free introductory call to chat about your vision, your desires, and your perfect way to travel.
Creation of a custom draft itinerary designed just for you, which we can review and adjust together based on your budget and needs.
Finalization of the approved itinerary, booking confirmation, and delivery of all essential travel documents and tips.
Pack your bags and leave your worries behind; I will take care of every detail.

domande.domanda: What does the first consultation include?
domande.risposta: The initial consultation is a complimentary video call lasting around 45 minutes to an hour. We’ll discuss your interests, budget, and expectations to see if my approach aligns with what you’re looking for.
Yes, if you prefer. Alternatively, if you want more flexibility, I can handle the local arrangements while you remain responsible for booking your own international flights.

domande.domanda: How much does the service cost?
domande.risposta: Pricing varies based on your chosen destination, the complexity, and the length of your trip. Following our discovery call, I’ll craft a personalized itinerary complete with a detailed quote.

domande.domanda: How far in advance should I contact you?
domande.risposta: Ideally 8-3 months before departure, to have the widest choice of accommodation and local guides.

domande.domanda: Do you work with large groups?
domande.risposta: I focus mainly on crafting tailor-made journeys for solo travelers, couples, and small groups. For group trips, I work with intimate groups of 6 to 10 people, the perfect size for a truly mindful, attentive, and respectful travel experience.

domande.domanda: Do you offer assistance during the trip?
domande.risposta: Yes. I remain reachable for the whole duration of the journey as a discreet point of contact.
